rationale: This chaincode contains standard HLF transaction entrypoints (Init/Invoke) with three operations: createDiamond, queryDiamond, and transferDiamond. None of the vulnerability patterns are present: no time.Now() (C1), no goroutines (C2), no map iteration (C3), no rich queries like GetQueryResult (C4), and no package-level mutable state (C6). All operations use deterministic GetState/PutState with explicit keys. The json.Marshal on a struct (not a map) is deterministic.
